name: American Samoa
summary_text: American Samoa: US nationals under customary Fa'a Samoa governance: sodomy law on the books, and the constitutional marriage definition was upheld against the SCOTUS marriage ruling (2024) — the least protective US territory. Scored as a dependent jurisdiction: the parent framework governs what a visitor encounters, plus local society and enforcement. Score re-anchored 2026-09-24: United States (0.36) plus a local delta of -0.18. This jurisdiction was not covered by the dedicated state/province research passes.

sources.title: Know Your Rights: Airport Security | A4TE
sources.claim_summary: Advocates for Trans Equality 'Know Your Rights' guide to US airport security (TSA): covers screening issues for trans travellers - body scanners flagging anatomy, pat-downs, documentation mismatches, and how to request alternative screening. Relevant to American Samoa as a US territory under US TSA procedures.

sources.title: US State Revokes Gender-Affirming Identification | Human Rights Watch
sources.claim_summary: Human Rights Watch (Mar 2026): 'US State Revokes Gender-Affirming Identification' — Kansas voids birth certificates and driver's licenses not matching sex assigned at birth; relevant to US-territory document policy.

sources.title: Introduction - Gender Identity and Sexual Identity in the Pacific and Hawai'i - Research Guides at University of Hawaii at Manoa
sources.claim_summary: University of Hawaii library research guide on Pacific sexual identity: academic resource collection on gender diversity and sexual identities across the Pacific, including American Samoa (fa'afafine and related third-gender traditions).

sources.title: American Samoa | A4TE
sources.claim_summary: Advocates for Trans Equality ID Documents Center page for American Samoa: tagged resource page on identity-document rules for trans people in the US territory.

sources.title: Gay-friendly American Samoa
sources.claim_summary: Out Traveler 'Ask the Expert' (2009): reader question on whether American Samoa is gay-friendly for a honeymoon - travel-editor answer describing the Samoan archipelago and tolerance context.

sources.title: Same-sex marriage: American Samoa may be the only territory in the US where the historic Supreme Court ruling does not apply | The Independent | The Independent
sources.claim_summary: The Independent (July 2015): American Samoa may be the only US territory where the Supreme Court's same-sex marriage ruling does not apply - the Attorney General said the territory was 'still reviewing' the decision; every other territory adopted it voluntarily.
